title: Actual, safe childcare for FELLOWSHIP

source.note: The organizer requested that actual childcare, rather than an invented supper, be the first real nuThang need. Event venue and public schedule follow the organizer-approved FELLOWSHIP outreach brief.

event.name: FELLOWSHIP: Family & Friends Open Mic Night

service.requested: Real, organized, age-appropriate on-site childcare or supervised children's program during agreed parts of the FELLOWSHIP event

doNotCollectInGitHub: names, ages or birthdates of individual children
parent or guardian identities, phone numbers and custody or pickup arrangements
health, allergy, disability or emergency details
background check records, addresses or identifying details of volunteer candidates
dataBoundary.privateProcessOwner: Authorized church child-safety lead and parents or guardians, not nuThang

safetyGates: Authorized Riverside/FELLOWSHIP host decides whether any care will be offered and determines applicable Minnesota licensing requirements
Host selects, screens and approves caregivers under a written safeguarding policy, including a two-adult practice where applicable
Host checks age-appropriate staffing capacity and the suitability of the designated space
Host establishes parent or guardian authorization, attendance and release procedures, emergency response and escalation
Host determines precise hours and communicates what care is or is not available
Actual adult caregivers explicitly accept the specific commitment; public interest is never automatic assignment
fallback: Until host-authorized, properly staffed childcare is confirmed, do not advertise childcare as available. Children remain in the care of their parent or legal guardian; explore parent-accompanied participation or a guardian-supported family area only with host agreement.
nextPublicStep: Ask the authorized Riverside event/children's-ministry lead whether the church can approve a safe program for a defined portion of December 4; request private age/count planning through the host, not via a public form.
doesNotClaim: any person is screened, trained, licensed, cleared, assigned, or volunteering
host authorization, guardian consent, or legal exemption
any child's attendance, safety or identity
